scripts.build: vite build && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup.html && cp -r icons dist/icons
scripts.build:dev: vite build --mode development && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && node scripts/patch-manifest-dev.js && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup.html && cp -r icons dist/icons
scripts.pack: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../zima-extension.zip . && cd ..
